A '''parka''' was a type of clothing worn in cold weather environments.

==History==
Parkas were utilized during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] by the non-[[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] personnel whenever stationed on frigid planets. [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] wore them while investigating [[Glid Station/Legends|Glid Station]] on [[Orto Plutonia/Legends|Orto Plutonia]], a [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outpost that had failed to check in.<ref name="Trespass">{{TCW|Trespass}}</ref> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kendal Ozzel]] and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Tauht]], [[Plo Koon/Legends|Koon]] and [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Fisto]] all wore parkas during the [[Battle of Khorm/Legends|Battle of]] [[Khorm/Legends|Khorm]].<ref name="ISotR">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: In Service of the Republic]]''</ref>

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] wore a electrically heated parka on [[Rafa V]] in [[5 BBY/Legends|5 BBY]]. It had a thermoknob that could be used to adjust the heating setting. The maximum setting was Emergency Full.<ref name="LCMS">''[[Lando Calrissian and the Mindharp of Sharu]]''</ref>

Almost all of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel stationed at [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] wore some form of parka to protect themselves from the harsh icy conditions of that [[Planet/Legends|world]].<ref name="TESB">{{Film|V}}</ref>
